spell.iron_spell_grimoire.summon_greatsw: Empty main hand: summon the Demon Slayer Sword. Holding it: summon the Demon Dweller Sword into your off hand. Holding both: Twin Swap - flip them between your hands with a burst of speed. Swapping to the Dweller makes the Slayer spin a 360 degree Whirlwind cut; swapping to the Slayer makes the Dweller fire a Volley of three dark crescents. The swap strike can trigger every 4 seconds. Costs no mana.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.empty_hand_requir: Your main hand must be empty (or hold the Demon Slayer Sword) to use this spell.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.grimoire_only: This spell can only be cast from the Black Grimoire.
Thrust the sword forward and dash through your enemies. With the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand the dash is faster and trails dark smoke, but hits lighter. Costs no mana.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.sword_required: Hold the Demon Slayer Sword to use this spell.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.demon_slayer: Vanishes the moment it leaves your hand.
Heavy, slow, and unbreakable. Cuts spells apart: 35% less spell damage while held.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.zetten.guide: Concentrate anti magic into the sword and bring it down in one huge vertical slash. With the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand it becomes a fast X of two dark slashes. Costs no mana.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.sky_splitter.g: Drain anti magic into the blade, then cleave upward: a towering black crescent flies forward, cutting through everything in its path and stopping at walls. Behind it the sky splits open - and a moment later the rift snaps shut, cutting everything inside it again. With the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand it becomes two crescents crossed in an X. Costs no mana.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.anti_magic.gui: Release anti magic from the sword in a wave that strips every magical effect from nearby enemies, breaks any spell they are casting, and cleanses your own ailments. Costs no mana.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.ki_sense.guide: Open your sixth sense: for 12 seconds every creature within 32 blocks shows through walls as a faint flame of ki - red for monsters, green for passive creatures, yellow for neutral ones and blue for players. Only you can see it. Costs no mana.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.instinct_guard: Enter a 2 second ki stance: no attack can hurt you, and the first enemy to strike you within 6 blocks gets countered - you blink behind them and cut them down, leaving them slowed and weakened. Costs no mana.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_union.gu: Liebe merges with you for 50 seconds: more attack damage, speed, attack speed and knockback resistance, devil regeneration, 35% less damage and 70% less spell damage, wrapped in black devil flame. Costs no mana. While it lasts, every spell in the grimoire becomes its devil version. While the union lasts you can fly: in the air press Jump to spread the wings and hover; W flies where you look, S brakes, A/D drift, hold Jump to rise, hold Sneak to sink; land to fold them. No fall damage.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.offhand_empty_req: Your off hand must be empty to summon the Demon Dweller Sword.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.demon_dwelle: Fast twin of the Demon Slayer Sword: lower damage, much faster swings.
Vanishes when it isn't in your hands. In the off hand: +2 attack damage, +0.4 attack speed. 35% less spell damage while held.
Send a projected slash of Anti Magic flying out of the Demon Dweller Sword. It cuts everything in its path, stops at walls and strips their magical effects. Needs the Demon Dweller Sword in either hand. Costs no mana.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.borrowed_slash: The Demon Dweller Sword borrows magic from the world around you: the projected slash takes on a random element - fire, ice, lightning or wind. Needs the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand. Costs no mana.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.dweller_required: Hold the Demon Dweller Sword to use this spell.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.any_sword_require: Hold the Demon Slayer Sword or the Demon Dweller Sword to use this spell.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.cast_broken: Your spell was broken by anti magic!
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.dark_grimoir: The first time you fall below 25% health, every spell cooldown resets and you heal 25% of your health. Once every 90 seconds. Ten spells, from Black Blade to Event Horizon.
A three-leaf grimoire of Dark Magic from the Land of the Sun.
Required for the Dark Grimoire's sword techniques.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.dark_grimoire_onl: This spell can only be cast from the Dark Grimoire.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.surpass_limits: Surpass your limits. Right here, right now!
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.black_blade.gu: Coat your blade - and yourself - in darkness for 20 seconds (a black-flame aura burns around you): every melee hit deals +6 damage and swallows 20 of the target's mana. Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: every hit also cuts the next enemy in the zone.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.dimension_slas: Sink into the draw stance, then one horizontal iaido cut: a towering wave of black flame rolls 40 blocks forward, widening as it goes, cutting everything it passes through, and leaves the tears of cut space behind. Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: one huge ring-shaped slash sweeps out through the whole zone and cuts every enemy inside.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.avidya_slash.g: A slash guided by ki. It bends in flight toward the enemy you are looking at (up to 30 blocks, must be in sight). Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: three slashes tear out of the zone's edge around the target and converge on it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.black_cocoon.g: Wrap yourself in a solid sphere of darkness for 4 s. Every hit and every spell is swallowed by the shell, you can't fall, and you move 60% faster inside it. When it opens it bursts: everything within 4 blocks is cut and thrown back, harder for every blow it swallowed. Mana Zone: it lasts 6 s and the burst also cuts every enemy in the zone.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.death_thrust.g: A piercing thrust of darkness 12 blocks straight ahead. Hits everything in the line and drives it back. Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: the thrust comes out of the dark behind the three nearest enemies.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.black_moon.gui: Raise a black moon above you for 4 seconds: every spell that would hit you is pulled into it in a spiral of darkness. Then it collapses and dives out as two crossed black crescents, bigger the more it swallowed, carrying half of the damage it absorbed. Mana Zone: lasts 6 seconds and breaks into a crescent aimed at every enemy in the zone.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.black_hole.gui: Open a hole of darkness where you look. For 3 seconds it drags enemies in and grinds them, then collapses. Mana Zone: opens in the middle of the enemies in the zone, pulls from further and lasts longer.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mana_zone_dime: Spread your mana 14 blocks around you for 20 seconds. Inside it you read the ki of every creature - bright flames, a ring at their feet and a beacon over their heads, visible through walls (red monsters, green passive, yellow neutral, blue players). While the zone is up, every Dark Grimoire move becomes its Mana Zone variant (see each spell). When it ends the zone collapses and cuts every enemy still inside.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.ki_foresight.g: Read the ki of everything around you. For 5 seconds the next 3 attacks miss as you sidestep them. Mana Zone: 5 dodges, and every attack you read is answered with a cut.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.event_horizon: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash: Event Horizon
Gather darkness for one second as it swells around you, then release a colossal wave of darkness: a towering black-flame front with giant crescents inside, rolling 55 blocks forward and widening as it goes. The horizon stays open behind it for 2 seconds, pulling enemies back in and cutting them again. Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: the wave is much bigger and reaches 90 blocks.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.katana_required: Hold the Dark Katana in your main hand to use this technique.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.steel_grimoi: Projectiles deal 25% less damage to you. Eight spells, from Violent Rotating Lance to Acier Silva.
A three-leaf grimoire of Steel Magic, kept in perfect order.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.steel_grimoire_on: This spell can only be cast from the Steel Grimoire.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.violent_rotati: Create a steel lance that spins as it flies, drilling through every enemy in its path until it hits a wall.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.blazing_spiral: Wind up, then drive a blazing lance spiralling into the first enemy ahead (10 blocks). Heavy damage, and it staggers them for 2 seconds.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.steel_castle_w: Seven steel slabs slam up out of the ground in front of you, crowned with gold battlements, for 12 seconds. The slabs erupt under anyone standing there - damage, thrown up and back. While it stands, nothing from the other side can hurt you or any player sheltering behind it, arrows and spells that hit its face are thrown back the way they came (and count as yours), and enemies can't walk through it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.white_steel_ho: Steel plates fly in from all around and lock together into a white-steel chariot pulled by a steel horse, then it charges forward: the horse gallops, the wheels spin, and everything in front is trampled and thrown aside. Allies close by ride in its wake. At the end, or at a wall, it bursts apart into flying steel with a shockwave.
Steel rails form and charge for one second, then fire a steel bolt like a railgun: 48 blocks, through every enemy in line. The recoil pushes you back.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.acier_silva.gu: A forest of steel spikes erupts around you in three widening rings, striking and lifting enemies.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.steel_prison.g: Lock the enemy you are looking at inside steel bars for 3 seconds - it can't move - then the prison crushes shut.
Steel plates fly in and lock onto you: for 40 seconds you wear full knight's armor - visored helm with a red plume, breastplate, pauldrons, greaves - and a red cape. +10 armor, +6 toughness, strong footing. The cape is real: attacks from behind you deal half damage. 2 minute cooldown.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_summon.g: Devil Union: summon and swap as usual, but every swap strike uses both swords at once - the Slayer's whirlwind and the Dweller's volley together, wreathed in ember. Strikes every 3 seconds.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_piercing: Devil Union: a faster, longer piercing dash that leaves a trail of ember. Half a second later the whole trail bursts, hitting everything along it again.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_zetten.g: Devil Union: the sword in your main hand brings down its Zetten and leaves an ember crater - then the other sword follows with its own.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_sky_spli: Devil Union: a stronger Sky Splitter from your main-hand sword, then a second one from the other sword - two rifts in a row.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_anti_mag: Devil Union: the anti magic wave, then a domain out to 16 blocks that breaks every cast again and cuts anyone carrying magic. Slayer: a crushing dome. Dweller: eight dark crescents fly out.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_ki_sense: Devil Union: Ki Sense reaching 48 blocks, lasting 20 seconds.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_instinct: Devil Union: a 3 second stance that counters EVERY attack (up to one every 0.3 seconds), each counter 50% harder.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_union_re: End the union early in one blast around you. The more union time is left, the harder it hits (up to 3x). Slayer: a meteor of darkness slams down. Dweller: a vortex tears outward.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_dweller_: Devil Union: three anti magic crescents in a row. With the Demon Slayer Sword also in hand, it finishes with a sweeping cut.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_borrowed: Devil Union: fire, ice, lightning and wind slashes, one after another in a different order every cast. Needs the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.dweller_main_requ: Hold the Demon-Dweller Sword in your main hand.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.zone.open: Mana Zone - every Dark move changes
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.zone.dimension_sl: Mana Zone: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_black_me: Devil Union only (takes Ki Sense's place). Rocket at the enemy you aim at (28 blocks). On contact a cutscene plays: an uppercut throws them into the air, you blink around them cutting through them a dozen times, then come down from above like a black meteor with one huge slash, driving them into the ground in a burning crater. They can't die until the final blow, and you can't be hurt while it plays. Miss and it ends. Needs a sword in your main hand.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.wind_grimoir: No fall damage - a gust always catches you. 25% of arrows and projectiles aimed at you are blown aside. Ten spells, from Wind Blade Shower to Spirit Storm.
A four-leaf grimoire, chosen by the spirit of wind.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.wind_grimoire_onl: Only the Wind Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.wind_blade_sho: Sweep your hand and a fan of seven wind blades flies out 26 blocks. Spirit Dive: thirteen blades in a wider fan, each bending toward an enemy in front of it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.tornado_fang.g: Hurl a tornado that rolls forward along the ground for 2.5 s. It drags enemies into its spin and cuts them, tears apart any projectile it touches, and at the end flings everything inside it into the sky. Spirit Dive: a huge tornado that lasts 4 s and pulls from much further away.
Bell blows: a great gust in a 60-degree cone, 10 blocks long. Everything in it is hit and thrown far back. Spirit Dive: 80 degrees, 14 blocks, and it throws them into the air.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.gale_white_bow: A bow of wind forms in your hand: loose three arrows of wind that fly 60 blocks and pierce everything they pass through. Spirit Dive: five arrows that seek out enemies.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.hushed_dance.g: Take the mana around you under your control and read every movement in it. For 6 s the next 3 attacks miss as the wind carries you aside, and each dodge refills 15 mana. Spirit Dive: 8 s, 5 dodges, and every dodge answers with a wind blade.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.spirit_of_zeph: A sword of wind in your hand: three fast cuts (across, down, rising), each throwing a thin blade of wind 22 blocks ahead and carrying you a step forward. Spirit Dive: Saint Spirit of Zephyr - the third cut becomes one colossal blade of wind that splits 30 blocks.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.spirit_of_bore: Four halberds of wind form and circle you, then fly at your enemies one after another and pierce through them. Spirit Dive: eight halberds.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.spirit_of_euro: Draw a great bow of condensed mana while the arrow gathers, then loose one tremendous arrow that pierces everything for 80 blocks. Spirit Dive: a bigger arrow that bursts into a storm of wind where it ends.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.spirit_dive.gu: Merge with Sylph for 30 s. Four wings of wind open on your back and you can fly: jump in the air to take off, W flies where you look, S brakes, hold Jump to rise and Sneak to sink. You move 30% faster, take no fall damage, and every other Wind Grimoire move turns into its Spirit Dive form.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.spirit_storm.g: Gather the mana around you as streams of wind pour into your hands, then release it as one vast storm of wind, 50 blocks long, that hits everything in it and drives it away. Spirit Dive: Double Spirit Storm - two storms twisting around each other, wider and 70 blocks long.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.dive.open: Spirit Dive - Sylph is with you
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.mercury_grim: When something hits you in melee, a spike of mercury lashes back at it (once a second). Ten spells, from Mercury Bullets to Mercury Cage.
A three-leaf grimoire of the royal Silva house.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.mercury_grimoire_: Only the Mercury Grimoire can cast this.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.silver_guardian.o: Silver Guardian - the mercury is poisoning you
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mercury_bullet: Fire six bullets of mercury one after another. They curve slightly onto the enemy you aim at.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mercury_spears: Three long spears of mercury rise beside you, turn to where you look, and launch 40 blocks, piercing everything in their path.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.silver_rain.gu: Raise your hand: a sheet of mercury gathers above the spot you look at (up to 30 blocks) and rains needles of mercury on a 6-block circle for 2.5 s, hitting and slowing everything under it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.storm_of_blade: Six swords of mercury form and circle you, then each one darts at an enemy and cuts through it.
An eagle of liquid mercury flies from your hand and hunts the enemy you aim at (or the nearest one ahead) for up to 3 s. When it strikes it bursts into a crown of mercury spikes.
Compress mercury into a mirror-smooth wall in front of you for 4 s. Projectiles that hit it are thrown straight back at their owner, and spells from the front are blocked.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mercury_sphere: A sphere of mercury closes over you and everyone within 3 blocks for 4 s. Projectiles that reach it are swallowed, and attacks from outside can't reach anyone inside.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.regal_spear.gu: Hold out your palm while mercury gathers into a shining sphere in it, then release it as a thin, blinding beam of mercury that cuts through everything, walls included, for 45 blocks.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.silver_guardia: Mercury flows over your whole body and hardens into flexible armour for 15 s. You take 60% less damage and can still move freely, but mercury is poison: you lose half a heart every 2 s while you wear it (it never takes you below 1 heart).
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mercury_cage.g: A giant cage of mercury bars drops over the spot you aim at (8 blocks across). Everything inside is held in for 3 s, then the bars snap inward and crush it.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.fire_grimoir: Every hit of these spells sets the target burning for 3 s. Below 30% health your fire hits 25% harder. Its fireballs fly in real arcs. Ten spells, from Exploding Fireball to Fire Cannon.
A commoner's grimoire, carried with nothing but guts.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.fire_grimoire_onl: Only the Fire Grimoire can cast this.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.soul_chain.on: Soul Chain Deathmatch - neither of you is going anywhere
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.soul_chain.miss: No one to chain - aim at an enemy
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.exploding_fire: Hurl a fireball that explodes on whatever it hits, burning everything within 3 blocks.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.explosive_scat: Five fireballs in a wide spread, each exploding where it lands.
Toss a huge fireball up in front of you and bat it straight at them with a bat of fire. It flies fast and explodes 5 blocks wide.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.flaming_bat.gu: A bat of fire: three heavy swings - two sweeps and an overhead smash - each one an arc of fire that hits and burns everything 5 blocks in front of you.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.flame_knuckles: Knuckledusters of fire for 12 s: every punch explodes on what it hits for 5 extra damage, knocks it back and sets it burning.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.ring_of_fire.g: Walls of fire spring up in a ring 7 blocks around you for 5 s. Anything that touches them burns and is thrown back.
Throw a fireball high into the sky: it splits, and nine fireballs rain down on a 6-block circle where you aimed.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.soul_chain.gui: Secret Fire Magic: a spell trap opens under the enemy you aim at and a burning chain binds the two of you for 10 s. They can't get more than 8 blocks away from you, and they take 30% more damage from your fire.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.fire_cannon.gu: Pour everything into one giant fireball held over your head, then hurl it. It explodes 8 blocks wide.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.lightning_gr: Every enemy you hit with these spells makes you 10% faster for 4 s (stacks 3 times). Ten spells of blue lightning, from Thunder Fist to Thunder Rampage.
A grimoire that crackles when its owner smiles.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.lightning_grimoir: Only the Lightning Grimoire can cast this.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.thunder_mode.open: Thunder God Mode - your body is lightning
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.thunder_mode.thun: Thunder God: Thunder Fist chains on
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thunder_fist.g: Flash to the enemy you aim at (up to 14 blocks) and punch them with a fist of lightning. Thunder God Mode: you flash on to two more enemies after it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thunder_kick.g: Three kicks of the Thunder God's boots, each one a lightning-fast step forward. The third launches them into the air. Thunder God Mode: longer steps, and lightning comes down on anyone you launch.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thunder_orb.gu: Three orbs of crackling lightning leave your hands, hunt the nearest enemies and burst on contact. Thunder God Mode: five orbs.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.lightning_step: Blink 12 blocks where you look in a flash of lightning, hitting everything you pass through. Thunder God Mode: 20 blocks.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.chain_lightnin: A bolt from your hand to the enemy you aim at, jumping on to the next nearest enemy, and the next - up to 6. Thunder God Mode: up to 10.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thunder_gloves: Gloves of lightning for 12 s: every punch discharges into the target for 3 extra damage and arcs on into the next enemy within 6 blocks.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mana_sense.gui: Luck's sense for mana, sharper than a noble's: every creature within 64 blocks is marked for 15 s, through walls. Thunder God Mode: 128 blocks.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thunderfall.gu: Call lightning down: for 2 s bolts strike from the sky on enemies within 12 blocks, one after another. Thunder God Mode: more strikes over 18 blocks.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thunder_god_mo: A bolt comes down into you and your whole body becomes lightning for 25 s: lightning crackles over every limb and your fists, sparks fly from your feet when you run, you move 40% faster, every melee hit calls a bolt down on the target, and every other move of the grimoire gets its Thunder God form.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thunder_rampag: Go berserk: flash from enemy to enemy within 16 blocks, hitting each from a different side, 10 flashes in all - then a great bolt comes down where most of them are. Thunder God Mode: 16 flashes.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.hellfire_gri: Your bare punches burn: +3 damage and 3 s of burning. Ten spells, from Calidos Brachium to Calidos Brachium Purgatory.
Its owner learned magic in the wild, not in a classroom.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.hellfire_grimoire: Only the Hellfire Grimoire can cast this.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.lion.no_target: No one to hit - aim at an enemy
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.lion_zone.open: Mana Zone - the mana around you is yours
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.hellfire.open: Hellfire Incarnate - your body is fire
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.hellfire.close: Hellfire Incarnate ended - your body pays for it
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.calidos_brachi: Punch: an arm of fire shoots out of your fist, its burning fist flying 16 blocks into the first thing it meets and blowing it back. Mana Zone: three arms, one after another.

Fists of fire appear all around the enemy you aim at and punch into it from every side - 8 punches in 1.5 s - then one huge fist from the front finishes it. Mana Zone: 16 punches, spread over every enemy in the zone.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.flame_lion_paw: Two great paws of fire seize the enemy you aim at, lift it high, and slam it into the ground. Mana Zone: a bigger blast where it lands.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.lioness_charge: Charge forward in a burst of fire and drive your fist into the first enemy in your way.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mana_skin.guid: Natural mana hardens over your whole body for 20 s: you take 35% less damage and can't be knocked back.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.lion_mana_zone: The mana around you (12 blocks, 20 s) serves you. The ground glows with heat and flames swirl around you. Press Jump in the air to step off the air itself (twice before landing), you slip one attack every 5 s, you take no fall damage, and your other moves get their Mana Zone forms.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.ground_punch.g: Drive your fist into the ground: rings of fire and pillars of flame erupt around you out to 8 blocks, throwing everything up. Mana Zone: 12 blocks.
Drive your burning fist into the ground: columns of crimson hellfire erupt under every enemy within 16 blocks (burning them and throwing them up), then one great column bursts up where you look.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.hellfire_incar: Your body becomes fire for 20 s, as if it were mana itself. Flames pour off you, everything within 3 blocks burns, your fire hits 30% harder - rising to 70% as it burns hotter - and your punches explode. When it ends your body pays for it: you lose a quarter of your health.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.calidos_brachi: Her strongest spell: blue flame gathers on your fist, then one punch releases a blast of blue fire that engulfs everything in front of you - a 30-block wave that widens as it goes. It burns away all of your remaining mana. In Mana Zone or Hellfire Incarnate: 45 blocks and wider.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.fireball_barra: Throw fireballs as fast as your arms can go: twelve in 1.2 s, alternating hands, each one flying where you look at that moment - sweep the stream across a crowd - and exploding where it lands.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.bone_grimoir: You regrow: 1 health every 4 s while you're hurt, once nothing has hit you for 5 s. Ten spells, from Bone Spear Volley to Beelzebub Union.
Its bones grow back faster than anything can break them.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.bone_grimoire_onl: Only the Bone Grimoire can cast this.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.bone.no_target: No one to hold - aim at an enemy
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.bone_spear_vol: Bone spears grow out in a fan behind your hand, then fly in a bunch - six of them - piercing everything for 40 blocks and sticking in walls. Beelzebub: ten.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.bone_spike_eru: Stamp: spikes of bone burst out of the ground in a widening line 16 blocks ahead, impaling and launching everything they meet. Beelzebub: 22 blocks.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.bone_sword.gui: Rake the air three times; each rake throws three claw-marks of bone that fly 16 blocks and cut everything on the way. Beelzebub: 26 blocks, with a wave of space behind them.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.bone_whips.gui: Four whips of vertebrae tear out of your back and lash at the enemies within 9 blocks for 1.5 s, each whip taking its own mark in turn. Beelzebub: six whips, 14 blocks.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.ribcage_prison: Giant ribs burst out of the ground around the enemy you aim at and close over it like a cage. It is held for 3 s, then the ribs snap inward.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.marrow_regener: Plates of bone grow over your body for 10 s while you regrow: you heal 30% of your health over the time and take 25% less damage.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.bone_thicket.g: A tangle of bones bursts out across a 7-block circle where you aim. Everything inside is caught in it - barely able to move - and cut for 4 s.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.spatial_cube.g: Beelzebub's spatial magic: a cube of space closes around the enemy you aim at, holding it perfectly still for 3 s, then folds in on it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.beelzebub_unio: Beelzebub's power for 25 s: horns and skeletal wings of bone grow from you, every bone spell hits 35% harder (and some grow bigger), and you move 30% faster.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.bone_spear_sto: A great wheel of ribs opens in the sky above the spot you aim at and spirals bone spears down for 3 s across a 9-block circle, then a giant spear for every enemy left. Beelzebub: a second wheel of space, wider and denser.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.mastery.is_on: Grimoire Mastery progression is ON: spells unlock as each book levels up.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.mastery.is_off: Grimoire Mastery progression is OFF: every spell is unlocked.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.mastery.no_book: No grimoire from this mod is equipped in the spellbook slot.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.mastery.bonu: Mastery bonus: +%s%% spell power, +%s%% cooldown reduction, +%s max mana
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.mastery.off: Grimoire Mastery off - every spell unlocked
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_black_di: Devil Union (takes Twin Rift's slot). Raise the sword overhead, then one cut releases a towering black blade 40 blocks forward that splits the ground and space, erases magic projectiles and breaks casts along its path.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.devil_black_hu: Devil Union (takes Devil Instinct's slot). Spin with both swords out inside a vortex of black flame for 2 s, dragging enemies in and shredding them, then burst outward and launch them.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.limit.end: Your limits settle back... for now.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.zone.equinox: Mana Zone: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash - Equinox
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.string_grimo: Your threads are always ready: spells cast from this grimoire recover 10% faster. Eight spells of Thread Magic, from Binding Threads to the Red Thread of Fate.
A three-leaf grimoire whose pages are bound with fine pink thread.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.spatial_grim: You move 5% faster. Eight spells of Spatial Magic, from Gate to Space Deletion.
A three-leaf grimoire edged in gold; its pages feel further away than they are.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.string_grimoire_o: Only the String Grimoire can cast this.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.spatial_grimoire_: Only the Spatial Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.binding_thread: Threads shoot from your fingertips and wrap the enemy you aim at, and up to three beside it, holding them still for 3 seconds.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.puppet_strings: Strings drop from above onto the enemy's limbs: they lift it up like a marionette, then slam it into the ground.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thread_net.gui: Weave a wide net of thread in front of you for 8 seconds. Enemy projectiles are caught in it and enemies cannot pass through.
Threads wind around you into a cocoon that soaks up the next blows for 8 seconds.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.stitching.guid: Threads stitch wounds closed: you and your allies within 6 blocks heal over 5 seconds.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.battle_dress.g: Weave yourself a dress of thread: +6 armour, +3 toughness and faster movement for 30 seconds.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thread_cage.gu: A great dome of threads closes over the area you aim at for 7 seconds. Enemies inside cannot leave - the threads throw them back and cut them.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.red_thread_of_: Thread Magic: Red Thread of Fate

A wheel of red thread turns above you and fate is rewritten for 20 seconds: the first three blows that you and each ally within 14 blocks would take never land, and whoever threw each one is snared in red thread.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.spatial_gate.g: Open a pair of gates in space - one before you and one where you look, up to 40 blocks. For 12 seconds anything that steps into one comes out of the other.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.short_hop.guid: A quick gate opens before you and another 12 blocks ahead: you step straight through.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.escort_gate.gu: A wide gate opens: you and every ally within 6 blocks are carried to where you look, up to 50 blocks away.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.waypoint.guide: Opens your waypoint menu. Save where you stand under a name you choose; click a saved place and a gate opens in front of you that stays open for 20 s. Nobody is carried unless they step in - you, your friends, or anything else that walks through. Waypoints never expire and you keep them through death.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.sky_drop.guide: A gate opens under the enemy you aim at (and up to three beside it) and drops them out of another gate 18 blocks up in the sky.
A gate opens before you for 5 seconds. Enemy projectiles that enter it come out of gates beside your enemies - flying at them.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.evasion_gate.g: For 8 seconds the next three blows on you meet a gate: you slip through it to one side, unhurt.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.space_deletion: Space is torn out where you aim: a black tear edged with gold draws everything nearby in, then the space is deleted - crushing everyone caught in it.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.open_book: Sneak + use: open the grimoire - every spell, its numbers and its combos.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.black_grimoi: Drains your mana away while worn, and its spells cost none. Its power flows into your body instead. Ten spells, from Zetten to Devil Union.
A tattered five-leaf grimoire. A devil sleeps in its pages.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mana_zone.guid: Spread your mana through the air around you and feel everything inside it. For 20 s, every second a blade of wind appears beside each enemy (up to 3) within 12 blocks and cuts it - no aiming, the wind answers from anywhere. Spirit Dive: five enemies at once, stronger blades.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.water_grimoi: Whatever your water hits is soaked and moves a quarter slower for a few seconds. Eight spells of Water Magic, from Water Ball to Sea Dragon's Wrath.
A three-leaf grimoire of the royal Silva house, cool to the touch.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.mirror_grimo: Spells cast from this grimoire recover 6% faster. Eight spells of Mirror Magic, from Mirror Shard to the Hall of Mirrors.
A three-leaf grimoire whose silver cover shows you more than your face.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.rift_grimoir: Your spatial magic cuts 30% harder and your blows land a little harder. Eight spells of offensive Spatial Magic, from Spatial Cut to Dimensional Severance.
A three-leaf grimoire whose pages are cut as cleanly as the space around it.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.water_grimoire_on: Only the Water Grimoire can cast this.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.mirror_grimoire_o: Only the Mirror Grimoire can cast this.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.rift_grimoire_onl: Only the Rift Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.water_ball.gui: Gather water in your palm and throw it. The sphere flies ahead and bursts into a splash that hurts and soaks everything near where it lands.
A thin, hard jet of water through everything in a straight line, 24 blocks long. It throws enemies back and soaks them.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.sea_dragons_ne: A swirling sphere of water forms where you aim. For 2 s it drags every enemy within 4 blocks in, holds them and batters them, then bursts and throws them out.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.aqua_barrage.g: Five water balls thrown in a fan, one after another, each bursting on whatever it meets.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.tidal_wave.gui: A breaking wave rolls out ahead of you for 20 blocks and carries every enemy in it away.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.sea_serpent.gu: A serpent of water snakes forward through your enemies, hitting each one it touches and bursting at the end.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.valkyrie_dress: Water rises round you and sets into armour. For 20 s you take less damage (+8 armor, +4 toughness) and move 12% faster.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.sea_dragons_wr: A great dragon of water rises from the sea around you, arcs over and crashes down where you aim, throwing everything within 7 blocks up and away. Surpassing Limits: Sea Dragon's Domain - a vast dome of water holds everything near you in the air while three dragons circle, then floods outward.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mirror_shard.g: A mirror opens before you and three shards of light fly out of it in a fan.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mirror_step.gu: Step into a mirror and out of another 10 blocks ahead.
For 8 s the next four blows on you meet a mirror: they never land, and 60% of each is thrown back at whatever struck you.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.prism_beam.gui: A beam of light that hits the enemy you aim at, then bounces off mirrors to up to three more.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mirror_cage.gu: Six mirrors close round the enemy you aim at. For 3.5 s it can barely move while every mirror in turn cuts it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mirror_barrage: Mirrors circle you and fire volley after volley of shards at every enemy within 16 blocks.
Slip into a mirror and step out behind the enemy you aim at, cutting as you arrive.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.hall_of_mirror: A dome of mirrors closes round the enemies near where you aim. For 3 s light strikes them from every pane, then the dome shatters inward. Surpassing Limits: Infinite Reflection - a bigger dome, 5 s of reflections and a harder shatter.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.spatial_cut.gu: A cut in space appears on the enemy you aim at, and the space snaps shut on it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.rift_blades.gu: Three gates open around the enemy you aim at and a blade comes out of each.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.blink_strike.g: Step through a gate and come out behind the enemy you aim at, cutting space as you arrive.
One long straight cut through everything ahead of you. A moment later the severed space snaps shut and drags nearby enemies in.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.gate_barrage.g: A ring of small gates opens round you and fires blade after blade at the enemies near you.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.space_collapse: A cube of space is cut out where you aim: everything in it is pulled to its centre, then the cube is crushed.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.convergence.gu: Twelve blades come out of gates all round the enemy you aim at and close on it from every direction.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.dimensional_se: Space itself is cut open along a line 24 blocks long where you aim, a great gash that holds open while everything along it is severed. Surpassing Limits: Absolute Severance - five cuts in a row, then the severed space folds in and is crushed.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.flame_spirit: Whatever your flames hit keeps burning for three more pulses. Eight spells of Flame Spirit Magic, from Salamander Flare to Great Salamander.
A crimson grimoire kept by the Vermillion house; the Salamander sleeps in its pages.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.flame_spirit_grim: Only the Flame Spirit Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.salamander_fla: Gather spirit-flame in your palm and send it ahead. It bursts in a crown of flame where it lands.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.spirit_lance.g: A white-hot lance of flame wrapped in a corkscrew, 26 blocks long, through everything in a line.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.flame_aegis.gu: Three rings of flame turn round you for 5 s, throwing back and burning anything that comes near, and make you tougher while they last. They burst outward when they end.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.salamander_coi: The spirit itself, a serpent of fire, coils forward through your enemies, striking each one it touches.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.flare_volley.g: Seven spears of flame fall one after another on the spot you aim at.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.salamander_rus: You become the spirit and tear forward 11 blocks, wrapped in flame, hitting everything on the way.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.salamander_spi: For 20 s the Salamander wraps you in flame: tougher, faster, steadier, and everything that stands close is scorched. A little spirit runs circles round you.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.great_salamand: A great fire spirit rushes out, rears above the spot you aim at and crashes down, hurting everything within 7 blocks. Surpassing Limits: Salamander Realm.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.lions_flame_: Every fifth blow of yours lands 60% harder. Eight spells of Lion's Flame Magic, from Ember Fist to King Lion's Roar.
Its pages are scorched at the edges, as if it had been fought over.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.lions_flame_grimo: Only the Lion's Flame Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.ember_fist.gui: Punch a flaming fist ahead. It hits hard where it lands and throws the target back.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.lion_claw.guid: Three claws of flame rake the air in front of you in quick succession.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.flame_leap.gui: Spring high trailing fire and come down in a crater of flame, throwing everything near up and out.
A cone of flame bursts from your open hands, ring after ring, to the sound of a roar.
A flurry of ten flaming blows and a heavy last one that shatters the air in front of you.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.prowl_dash.gui: A fast low rush of 9 blocks that ends in a crossing double claw.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.mane_blaze.gui: For 20 s a mane of flame burns round your head: you are far faster, hit quicker and harder, and scorch all who stand near.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.king_lion_roar: Lion's Flame Magic: King Lion's Roar
A lion's head of flame forms ahead of you, turns, and roars a great beam of fire 28 blocks long. Surpassing Limits: Lion King's Domain.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.world_tree_g: Every blow of yours mends you a little. Eight spells of World Tree Magic, from Thorn Bolt to World Tree's Judgement.
Its cover is warm, like bark in the sun, and sometimes a leaf falls out.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.world_tree_grimoi: Only the World Tree Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thorn_bolt.gui: A seed of thorns that flies ahead and bursts into spikes where it lands.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.vine_lash.guid: A vine whips out, wraps what it hits and drags it back to you.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.root_snare.gui: Roots burst from the ground where you aim and hold everything inside, heavily slowed, for 3.5 s.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.leaf_storm.gui: A ring of razor leaves turns round you for 2 s, cutting and pushing away all that come near.
Flowers open round you: you mend 4 hearts, and the petals cut everything standing close.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.treant_guardia: A guardian of living wood brings its fist down three times ahead of you, each blow farther than the last.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.world_tree_man: World Tree Magic: World Tree Mantle
For 20 s bark and leaves cover you: far tougher, steadier on your feet, and slowly mending.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.world_tree_jud: World Tree Magic: World Tree's Judgement
A colossal tree rises where you aim; its boughs spread and drive down through everything within 8 blocks, and the crown comes down in leaves. Surpassing Limits: World Tree Genesis.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.slash_grimoi: Your cuts keep bleeding for three more pulses, and anything near death takes 30% more. Eight spells of Slash Magic, from Phantom Slash to Bloody Massacre.
Every page is sliced clean along one edge. No one has seen the blade.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.slash_grimoire_on: Only the Slash Grimoire can cast this.
A hair-thin line appears ahead of you; a breath later it cuts everything it crosses, 22 blocks long.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.crescent_cut.g: A great crescent of edge flies out and cuts through everything in its way.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.shadow_step_sl: You are behind your mark before it knows and it is already cut twice. With nothing to step to, you blur forward instead.
Eighteen cuts at one spot, faster than the eye, and a long last cut to finish.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.cross_reaper.g: An X is drawn in the air ahead of you, line by line, then tears apart and hurls everything near it back.
Up to six foes in front of you are marked with a thin cut that opens, deeper, two seconds later.
For 15 s you are a blur: far faster, with cuts opening round you and on every enemy that comes near.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.bloody_massacr: You cut through up to eight enemies near you in turn, return to where you began, and every cut opens at once. Surpassing Limits: Endless Night. Cast it in Surpassing Limits while Ripper Frenzy is running and it becomes Ripper's Horizon: a long charge with both arms raised, then one colossal green slash that splits space along its whole path.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.earth_grimoi: Whatever your stone hits moves a fifth slower for two seconds. All stone is conjured: nothing in the world is moved or broken. Eight spells of Earth Magic, from Stone Fist to Mountain Fall.
It is heavy for its size and always cool, like a stone taken from a river.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.earth_grimoire_on: Only the Earth Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.stone_fist.gui: A fist of rock rises ahead of you and drives forward 5 blocks, throwing back what it meets.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.rock_spike.gui: A line of rock spikes tears up the ground in front of you, one after another, 16 blocks long.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.earth_wall.gui: A wall of rock stands up ahead for 4 s and shoves away everything that touches it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.boulder_toss.g: A boulder is torn from the ground and thrown in an arc; it shatters into slabs where it lands.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.quake_stomp.gu: You stamp: three shock rings roll out, the ground cracks and everything near is flung up.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.stone_golem.gu: A golem of rock stands up behind you for 3 s and punches your nearest foes five times.
For 20 s plates of rock circle you: far tougher and impossible to knock back, at the cost of a little speed.
A ring marks the ground you aim at; a second later a mountain's worth of rock falls on it, crushing everything within 8 blocks. Surpassing Limits: Earth Titan.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.beast_grimoi: Anything under half health takes 25% more from your blows. Eight spells of Beast Magic, from Wolf Fang to Primal King.
It smells faintly of rain and fur, and the pages are marked with claws.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.beast_grimoire_on: Only the Beast Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.wolf_fang.guid: A spirit wolf bounds ahead and bites the first thing it reaches.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.hawk_dive.guid: A hawk circles high above your mark, then drops on it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.bear_swipe.gui: A bear's paw rakes three huge claws across the front of you.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.panther_pounce: You spring onto your mark and rake it with a crossing double claw.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.stampede.guide: A herd of beasts runs ahead of you and tramples everything in its path.
A serpent winds up the legs of every foe near the spot you aim at and holds them almost still for 4 s.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.beast_instinct: For 20 s the wolf's spirit runs through you: far faster and quicker to strike, and you bite what comes near.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.primal_king.gu: Five great spirits - wolf, hawk, bear, panther and stag - close on the spot you aim at from every side and meet there in one blow. Surpassing Limits: Primal Ancestor.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.cotton_grimo: Each blow of yours feeds you a little, and leaves the target stuck in cotton for a moment. Eight spells of Cotton Magic, from Cotton Ball to Grand Banquet.
It is soft, pink, a little sticky, and there are crumbs in the binding.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.cotton_grimoire_o: Only the Cotton Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.cotton_ball.gu: A puff of cotton thrown ahead; it bursts into a sticky cloud that slows what it covers.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.cotton_net.gui: A lattice of cotton is flung ahead of you, gluing everything in the cone to the spot.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.neans_charge.g: Nean, the cotton sheep, lowers her head and runs straight through your foes for 16 blocks.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.cream_puff_bar: A volley of seven pastries lobbed in a fan, each bursting in cream.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.sweet_feast.gu: You eat: you mend 3.5 hearts, your hunger fills, a sugar rush carries you for 8 s and a shock of sugar throws back everything near.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.cotton_cloud.g: A great cloud of cotton settles where you aim, holding and lifting everything inside for 3 s before it bursts.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.nean_armor.gui: For 20 s you are wrapped in Nean's fleece: far tougher, steadier on your feet, and slowly mending.
A three-tier cake as big as a house falls on the spot you aim at, and Nean then runs down whoever survived. Surpassing Limits: Nean Colossus.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.time_grimoir: Every hit you land banks a second, up to ten; some spells spend them for more. Twelve spells of Time Magic, from Clock Hand Bolt to Zenith Hour.
A midnight grimoire with a clock for a heart. When its pages open, time holds its breath.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.time_grimoire_onl: Only the Time Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.clock_hand_bol: Flick a cyan clock hand straight ahead: it strikes the first foe and slows it. With 3 stored seconds, two hands fly.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.time_stop_poin: A cage of pages snaps shut round the foe you aim at: it is frozen for 1.5 s. 2 stored seconds add one more.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.time_skip.guid: Skip a few seconds: you are 8 blocks ahead, and your cyan silhouette is left standing where you were.
Your body rewinds to how it was 4 seconds ago. With 5 stored seconds, to your best moment of the last 6.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.chrono_acceler: Your own time runs fast for 6 s: you move and strike faster, and every cooldown runs twice as fast.
Lay a clock on the ground. It ticks three times; whoever is still standing on it then is frozen for 2 s inside a glassy time bubble with a ring of numerals.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.time_theft.gui: Cyan threads pull the time out of everything ahead of you: they are slowed, and you store 2 seconds for each.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.hourglass_barr: A clock opens over your target and its hands rain down, one every tick. With 4 stored seconds, half as many again.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.rewind_ward.gu: For 3 s, half of every hurt you take is written down - and then rewound back into you.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.echo_of_the_pa: Time Magic: Echo of the Past
A cyan afterimage of you stays behind and, 2 seconds later, recasts your last spell from where it stands, at half power.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.chronostasis_f: Mode: a column of pages surrounds you for 15 s. Inside, foes crawl, arrows hang in the air and your cooldowns run twice as fast.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.zenith_hour.gu: A vast column of pages bursts up and a great clock opens in the sky: time stops for every foe inside for 4 s. Your blows hang in the air and land all at once when it starts again.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.bloodfiend_g: Hardblood magic of La Manchaland. Hits leave Bleed, which hurts whenever the foe moves or swings; every point of Bleed damage is stored as Bloodfeast for skills to spend. Every cast hardens your Hardblood (up to 30): faster, then stronger, then tougher.
Not a book: the blood itself, set hard as steel into a knight's lance. Wear it where a grimoire goes. Gallop on!
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.caduceus_gri: A black rod on a gold chain - and from it, black slime that sets into any weapon. Every 20 s it hands you a Prescript; carry it out for Fortune and a burst of speed and strength. Your hits leave Fortuna: each stack makes the foe take 0.5% more damage, and at 40+ they hit 20% softer.
Not a book: the Index Proxy's weapon. Wear it where a grimoire goes. The Prescript is absolute.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.caduceus_grimoire: Only the Caduceus can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.hardblood_lanc: Thrust a long lance of hardblood 6 blocks (8 in Vampire Mode), piercing everything in line. Bleed 3.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.justice_charge: Level the lance and charge 12 blocks. The first foe is carried on the lance and slammed off at the end; everyone you pass bleeds.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.sanguine_cresc: A wide sweep throws a crescent of blood 11 blocks; it breaks into droplets that land as small blood spikes. Bleed 2.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.crimson_pact.g: Drink your own blood: lose 2 hearts, gain 150 Bloodfeast, 5 Hardblood and a 5 s burst of speed.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.thirst.guide: Every bleeding foe within 10 blocks is drained: streams of blood flow to you, healing you and filling Bloodfeast by their Bleed.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.hardblood_barr: A ring of blood spears rises round you for 4 s. Anything that touches it is thrown back and bleeds.
Draw a bow of blood and loose five heavy arrows one after another. Each pierces, trails blood and lands with a burst. In Vampire Mode the arrows seek bleeding foes.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.twin_blood_bla: Two curved sabres of blood: a fast six-cut spinning combo, ending in a cross-cut that bursts the target's Bleed.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.blood_fist_bar: Bare fists, blood on the knuckles: each arm pulls back and drives in - fifteen punches in 1.5 s - then one heavy blow that throws them. In Vampire Mode every punch heals you.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.hardblood_grea: One great blade brought down overhead; a wave runs 10 blocks along the ground and rises into blood spikes. With 500+ Bloodfeast the blade is twice the size and the wave runs 16 (costs 200).
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.vampire_mode.g: The bloodfiend wakes for 30 s: red eyes, a cape of blood, 20% more damage and speed, lifesteal, and Red Mist (double-tap sneak to burst 5 blocks ahead). Drains Bloodfeast.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.grand_finale: Hardblood: Grand Finale of La Manchaland
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.grand_finale.g: Leap; the sky over the target turns to blood and a huge lance is built from blood drawn out of the ground. Dive and drive it down: three shockwaves, a geyser of blood, a field of thorns blooming outward, then every bleeding foe within 14 blocks bursts. Spends all Bloodfeast for up to double damage.
The vial spins on its chain and black slime stretches into a whip-sword that cuts a wide arc in front of you. Fortuna 6.
A thin sword of black slime poured from the Caduceus: three precise thrusts. The third is a sure critical on a foe with 30+ Fortuna.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.reapers_prescr: A great scythe of black slime: one huge reap in front of you that always crits and pulls the foes in. Fortuna 10.
Black slime splits into fourteen small spikes fired like shot. Counts as a fired form for the Prescript.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.index_lance.gu: A long spear of black slime thrown straight and far; it pierces, then melts back into the Caduceus. A fired form.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.golden_shell.g: Black slime pours out of the Caduceus and wraps you as thin armour for 4 s (+14 armour, +8 toughness); whoever hits you is marked with Fortuna.
Fine threads of black slime bind the three nearest foes within 12 blocks in place for 2 s, cutting them.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.hammer_of_judg: A huge hammer of black slime forms overhead and comes down 3 blocks ahead. It cashes in all Fortuna on the foes it strikes for extra damage.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.prescript_rece: For 15 s you follow the Prescript perfectly: orders count double and come faster, and every skill hits 25% harder.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.furioso.guide: The Caduceus floods with black slime and every weapon strikes the target in turn - rapier, scythe, lance, hammer, daggers, gun, greatsword, whip - then all at once. Needs a full Fortune (100) for the whole nine-strike chain; less gives five.
ui.iron_spell_grimoire.light_grimoire_on: Only the Light Grimoire can cast this.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.light_sword.gu: Three swords of light form at your side and streak into the foe you aim at.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.light_speed_st: Flash-step twelve blocks in a line of light. Aim at a foe and you come out behind it and strike.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.arrows_of_judg: Twelve arrows of light rise over you, hang for a heartbeat, and fall on the foes around you.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.bright_judgmen: A whip of light sixteen blocks long lashes across in front of you, then back.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.healing_ray.gu: Heal the ally you aim at (or yourself), and a little more over the next two seconds.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.blinding_flash: Light bursts out of you: foes within 8 blocks are slowed, hit softer and lose track of you for 3 s. Players are blinded white for a moment.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.light_swords_o: Light Magic: Light Swords of Judgment
Rows of swords open in the sky over your target, shimmer, and rain down in a sweep.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.light_shaft: Light Magic: Light Shaft of Divine Punishment
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.light_shaft.gu: A circle draws itself on the ground where you aim, then a vast pillar of light comes down on it.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.demon_light.gu: Mode, 20 s: your light turns black and white. Light spells hit 35% harder, every cooldown runs twice as fast, and you move faster.
spell.iron_spell_grimoire.imperial_sword: Light Magic: Imperial Swords of Conviction
A storm of swords circles your target and closes in, wave after wave, then one giant sword falls. Surpassing Limits: Sovereign of Light - a wider storm, a bigger sword and a pillar of light.
tooltip.iron_spell_grimoire.light_grimoi: Every Light spell leaves you moving at light speed for a moment. Ten spells of Light Magic, from Light Sword to Imperial Swords of Conviction.
Light is the fastest magic there is. By the time they see it, it has already struck.
